answer: The island register is checked at draw time, vault lists the eligible set, and forge seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 68 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 68 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 213 account operation therefore ties up 13 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
